messages:
Maya (support): FYI customer reported weird negative tokens/sec in Console for a Dedicated tenant, started ~10:07 UTC. Screenshot attached: https://img.redwood.example/neg-tokens-03.png
Jon C (eng-runtime): Can you paste the tenant id + time window and any correlation id from the console?
Maya (support): tenant: tenant-ax42, window: 2026-11-02T10:05:00Z -> 10:12:00Z. Correlation id from UI: c2b7f4a3. Customer says API still works, just dashboard shows negatives.
support_bot: New ticket created: #INC-5321 (automated).
Drew (eng-sre): Negative rates usually mean the aggregator saw a counter drop (counter reset or reorder) and calculated a negative delta. Did we roll the streaming aggregator yesterday?
Maya (support): We deployed stats-aggregator v3.4.1 at 02:30 UTC yesterday (per release notes).
Jon C (eng-runtime): Ok. Two quick repro asks: 1) can you curl the raw streaming metrics endpoint for that tenant/time range? 2) paste the console query (timebucket + rollup) if possible.
Maya (support): Repro steps I used:
```
curl -s -H "X-Tenant: tenant-ax42" "https://metrics.redwood/api/v1/streaming?start=2026-11-02T10:05:00Z&end=2026-11-02T10:12:00Z&metric=tokens_per_sec"
```
Response snippet:
```
[
  {"ts":"2026-11-02T10:06:00Z","tokens_per_sec": 125.4},
  {"ts":"2026-11-02T10:07:00Z","tokens_per_sec": -18.7},
  {"ts":"2026-11-02T10:08:00Z","tokens_per_sec": 130.1}
]
```
Maya (support): so you can see a single negative spike in the middle. Customer attached full JSON.
Drew (eng-sre): Thanks. Can you also run the consumer offset check on the metrics topic for that tenant? e.g. from the metrics-ops host:
```
kafka-consumer-offsets --topic metrics-streaming --group agg-tenant-ax42 --describe
```
Jon C (eng-runtime): Also include the raw counter series (total_tokens) that the aggregator uses. If total_tokens decreased between windows we will compute negative rate.
Maya (support): Ran both, paste outputs:
```
# consumer offsets last 100 records show some out-of-order timestamps in partition 3, small re-ordering around 10:06:30
# total_tokens series sample: 1002345 -> 1002340 -> 1002475
```
Maya (support): notice total_tokens dropped by 5 then jumped up again.
Drew (eng-sre): That matches a producer re-send with an earlier sequence number hitting the aggregator after a later update. Our rate calc is naive: delta = curr_total - prev_total; if curr < prev -> negative. In most cases we clamp to 0 but v3.4.1 had a regression where clamping logic skipped for 1s buckets when reorder flag set.
Jon C (eng-runtime): Proposed mitigation: 1) immediate quickfix in dashboard layer to clamp negative rates to 0 for display (safe), 2) backfill patch to aggregator to apply monotonic counter logic + dedupe by sequence id. Can we do (1) now and then roll the aggregator fix tomorrow?
Angela (billing): Is there any billing impact? Customer worried charges might be negative or credits applied.
Jon C (eng-runtime): Billing reads raw total_tokens from ledger, not derived rates, so billing not affected. But we'll confirm with finance.
Drew (eng-sre): I'll push a dashboard-side clamp patch to prod now (small PR) and add a short feature flag. Will post PR link.
Maya (support): Thanks. I'll tell customer we expect UI-only fix in ~15m and keep them posted.
Drew (eng-sre): PR: https://git.redwood/metrics/+/8923 clamp-negatives. Deploying to canary.
Drew (eng-sre): Canary looks good, negative spikes no longer rendered. Scheduling full roll in 10m.
Maya (support): Customer confirmed UI shows zero instead of negative now. They said they can close ticket if aggregator fix is tracked.
Jon C (eng-runtime): Created follow-up issue to harden aggregator: AGG-711 (monotonic counters + seq dedupe). Owner: Jon C. ETA: patch + test by EOD tomorrow.
Angela (billing): Confirmed no billing impact. Closing concern. :white_check_mark:
Maya (support): Closing loop with customer and adding notes. Thanks all! :thanks:
